high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a person wearing a sweatshirt with a prominent graphic design on the front. The individual has long hair that falls over their shoulders and appears to be looking down, possibly at something out of frame. The sweatshirt features a detailed graphic of an eagle with its wings spread wide, set against a backdrop of stars and stripes, reminiscent of the American flag. Below the eagle, there is a circular emblem with the words "Genuine American" written around it.
